label: Episode
description: One episode of a TV show, a podcast or another series.

medium.description: What the episode is: tv, podcast, radio, video or mixed.

season_number.description: Which season, where the series has them

episode_number.description: Position within the season, or within the series when unseasoned

media_url.label: Media URL
media_url.description: The address of the media file itself, such as a podcast's audio or a film's stream. Not url, which is the web page about the work.

mime_type.label: MIME Type
mime_type.description: The MIME type of the file at media_url, such as audio/mpeg or video/mp4.
